messages.content: I finished curating a colorectal cancer H&E WSI dataset. I want to train a model to classify MSI versus MSS status. Can PathLab help me set this up as a WSI classification task?
Yes. Since the endpoint is MSI/MSS at the case level and the input is H&E whole-slide images, I recommend a WSI classification task with patient-level stratified train/validation/test splits.
The dataset has 312 WSIs: 96 MSI and 216 MSS. Please use an attention MIL model and a pathology foundation-model feature extractor.

I will configure a WSI classification task using CONCH-style features, attention MIL aggregation, class balancing, and early stopping. The paper topic should be colorectal cancer microsatellite instability prediction from H&E WSIs.
Good. After it finishes, I want the paper to focus on CRC MSI prediction, related work on computational pathology MSI prediction, WSI MIL, and evidence-locked reporting.
Understood. I will keep the manuscript topic as CRC MSI prediction from H&E WSIs and avoid claims about external validation or clinical readiness unless those results are provided.
